items.heading: Kathiyawadi Chicken Curry
details: Key ingredients: chicken, onion, garlic, coriander seeds, red chili
Saute a generous amount of onion until deep golden brown.
Add ground coriander seeds, garlic and red chili, cooking until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and sear until sealed on all sides.
Simmer until the chicken is tender and the gravy is thick and well spiced.
